Quezon Avenue, West Triangle, Quezon City wm,v.dil . ov. h OPINION NO. 20 HON. SOL F. MATUGAS Mayor Municipality of General Luna, Province of Surigao del Norte solfmatugas@gmail.com Dear Mayor Matugas: This refers to your letter dated 02 August 2024 seeking this Department's guidance on the following matters: a) Whether or not the Municipal Mayor can issue Special Permit to hold cockfighting activities during our local fiesta in September 2024 pursuant to the pertinent provisions of local govemment; b) If yes, whether or not cockfighting activities during our local fiesta may be conducted in any other place within our jurisdiction other than Marigot Cockpit (which while still has a franchise, it has no 2024 business permit); and c) Assuming the aforesaid cockfighting activities may only be held at Marigot Cockpit, what is our remedy if the owner of said cockpit will refuse to hold the cockfighting therein? As to the first and second queries, we opine in the negative. At the onset, we would like to emphasize that the Supreme Court made a pronouncement in the case of Tan vs. Perefial, stating that while the LGC now governs as to the authority of the Sanggunian to authorize or license establishment. operation. and maintenance of cockpits. it is still subject to the limitations laid down in PD 449. The Court even said that "there is no dichotomy between affirming the power and subjecting it to limitations at the same time. Pertinently, Section 5 of PD 449 lays down the guidelines in holding of cockfights, to wit: Section 5. Cockpits and Cockfighting: In General: (d) Holding of Cockfights. Except as provided in this Decree, cockfighting shall be allowed only in licensed cockpits during Sundays and Ieqal G.R. No. 149743, February 18, 2005. holidays and durinq local fiestas for not more than three days. It may also be held during provincial, city or municipal, agricultural, commercial or industrial fair, carnival or exposition for a similar period of three days upon resolution of the province, city or municipality where such fair, carnival or exposition is to be held, subject to the approval of the Chief of Constabulary or his authorized representative: Provided, that, no cockfighting on the occasion of such fair, camival or exposition shall be allowed within the month of a local fiesta or for more than two occasions a year in the same city or municipality: Provided, further, that no cockfighting shall be held on December 30 (Rizal Day), June 12 (Philippine Independence Day) November 30 (National Heroes Day), Holy Thursday, Good Friday, Election or Referendum Day and during Registration Days for such election or referendum. (e) Cockfighting for Entertainment of Tourists or for Charitable Purposes. Subject to the preceding subsection hereof, the Chief Constabulary or his authorized representative may also allow the holding of cockfighting for the entertainment of foreign dignitaries or for tourists, or for retuming Filipinos, commonly known as "Balikbayan",_or for the support of national fund-raising campaigns for charitable purposes as may be authorized by the Office of the President, upon resolution of a provincial board, city or municipal council, in licensed cockpits or in playgrounds or parks: Provided, that this privilege shall be extended for only one time, for a period not exceeding three days, within a year to a province, city, or municipality. It is clear from the afore-quoted provisions that cockfighting may only be held durinq Sundays. legal Holidays. local fiestas. in a licensed cockpit for not more than three (3) days. Therefore, to clarify, as to the issuance of license and permit for cockfighting operations, the authority belongs to the Sanggunian. As to issuance of special permits, the permitting authority for cockfights falling under Section 5(d) and (e), respectively, of P.D. 449 is vested upon the concerned sanggunian through a resolution but the actual operation of which is still subject to the approval of the local chief of police. Correspondingly, we deem it proper to clarify that under Republic Act No. 7160 or the Local Government Code of 1991 ("LGC") the Mayor does not have the authority to issue special permits for cockfighting. It is the Sangqunian. under the law. that has the authority to license the establishment and operation of cockfiqhtinq. Hence, the LGC places upon the Sangqunian, and not upon the Mayor. the authority to issue license for the operation of cockfiqht. Therefore, the Mayor does not have the authority to issue special permits for cockfighting. It is the Sanggunianq Panlungsodt under the law, that must pass a resolution in support of the special permit application. Further, while Marigot Cockpit still has a franchise, however, the same has not obtained a business permit for 2024. Accordingly, the purpose of a mayor's I business permit, which is to serve as a "license to operate". and is required for businesses to legally function or operate legally. Its issuance is dependent on whether all or not all the requirements set forth by law or ordinance for its issuance are met/submitted. Page 2 of 3

It is in this regard that we deem it proper to highlight the pronouncement of the Supreme Court in the case of Canet v. Decena2, to wit: "(i)t should, furthermore be borne in mind that cockfighting although authorized by law is still a form of gambling. Gambling is essentially antagonistic to the aims of enhancing national productivity and self-reliance. As has been previously said, a statue which authorizes amblin activity or business should be strictly construed. and every reasonable doubt resolved so as to limit rather than ex and the owers and ri hts claimed b franchise holders under its authorit Hence, we are of the position that the said cockfighting activity cannot be conducted in the Marigot Cockpit. As to the third query, considering that our position is that the said cockfighting activity cannot be held in Marigot Cockpit, such is now considered moot. Notwithstanding the foregoing, we would like to state that there is currently a pending bill in the House of Representatives which seeks to amend pertinent provisions of PD 447 specifically, granting the local chief executive the authority to authorize and license the establishment, operation, and maintenance of cockpits, and regulate cockfighting, with the concurrence of the Sanggunian members, which essentially, will also amend provisions of the LGC relating to the granting of cockfighting license and permits. This opinion is being rendered without prejudice to any contrary opinion of competent authorities and the courts. Very truly yours, BY THE AUTHORITY OF THE SECRETARY: ATTY. Unde N VICTOR R.
